text.text_excerpt: I love this market - not only for the great local (& sometimes a little not so local) artists / crafters / vendors but also for the live music, pet adoptions & good food & drink! Fish tacos, quite yummy!! Also had some red velvet cupcakes - hit the spot!! The crafters vary from kids having fund raisings to artsy crafters, jewelers, artists, vintage clothing, etc - good variety!! Check their dates online at http://freretmarket.org/ especially around the holidays as they can change or have more that month. Great to have tokens available if you don't have cash or if the artist doesn't take credit!! Good times!!!

This is such a cute neighborhood. And the live music really makes this a great market. I, unfortunately, was not a careful reader and was hoping to pick up some fruit and fresh flowers but it is not a farmers market it is just a market. They did have tons of yummy prepared foods (both ready to eat and canned) and tons of art (photos, painting and ceramics). Ok when I say tons it is one square block worth of market (which is not a lot) but the square block is FULL. I definitely plan on visiting some of these vendors for gifts and housing decoration sometime in the future. The money I had on hand was earmarked for food and I wasn't able to partake in the wares when I visited.

great variety + local non profits + great art = a wonderful place to spend a Saturday and pick up gifts while you enjoy food and music. I went during the holiday season so there were tons of booths and they all had something different. I loved that each booth was unique and was selling something that I wouldn't be able to find anywhere else. I also loved that they supported local non profits by providing them with space. Want to adopt a dog? There were plenty to choose from the day I was there. The music was great and I was able to find really unique gifts for my family. The only down fall was that there wasn't any veggie food to be found. I wish some local vegetarians would cook for this...
